_README: Domain-neutral configuration template. Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own role, location, employer, and topic settings. Empty search lists are intentionally fail-closed and produce no searches.

search_scope._comment: Canonical statement of the roles and geographies being targeted. Source-specific execution settings remain under search_terms and locations.

geography.remote_policy: Remote labels are discovery signals only; eligibility must be established separately.

skills._comment: Candidate signals for later deterministic ranking. Development opportunities are never exclusions.

negative_domains._comment: Off-target role families for later classification/ranking. Do not copy these into substring hard filters.

keywords._comment: A job title is retained when it matches an include term and does not match an exclude term. Keep hard exclusions conservative.
keywords._fuzzy_comment: Optional LinkedIn pre-filter. It is enabled only when both fuzzy_seniority and fuzzy_domain are non-empty.

search_terms._comment: Queries sent to each board. Empty lists disable discovery for that source without deleting its scraper.

locations._comment: Source-specific locations. LinkedIn geoId may be blank; JobSpy-backed boards use location plus country.
locations._linkedin_partitions_comment: Optional parallel-backfill locations. Leave empty unless partitioned LinkedIn backfill is configured.

location_filter._comment: Post-filter substrings for sources that cannot be geographically scoped at query time.

google_jobs._comment: Optional exact Google Jobs queries. Entries may be strings or objects with query/location/country fallback context. Prefer GitHub Actions secrets for credentials.

jobspy._comment: Optional proxy and user-agent configuration. Prefer GitHub Actions secrets for credentials.

employers._comment: Optional priority and exclusion lists. Both are empty in the domain-neutral baseline.

priority_topics._comment: Optional [display name, regex] pairs used for dashboard stars and notifications.

role_categories._comment: Optional [display name, regex] pairs used by the current dashboard Role filter.
